title: The 50/30/20 rule in 10 seconds
caption:
50% for needs, 30% for wants, 20% for savings and debt.
Earn $4,000 a month? $2,000 / $1,200 / $800.
comment: Which part is hardest for you? 👇
sources: The 50/30/20 budget (Elizabeth Warren and Amelia Warren Tyagi, All Your Worth, 2005). Math: 4,000 × 0.5 / 0.3 / 0.2

scenes.say: Fifty percent for needs, thirty for wants, twenty for savings.
That's two thousand, twelve hundred, and eight hundred.
